name: familybranch
description: Build your family tree in FamilyBranch from a conversation: add relatives with the dates you know, keep records and sources on their profiles, and make printable posters of the tree.

interface.longDescription:
FamilyBranch keeps a family's tree in one shared place that relatives build together. This plugin lets ChatGPT work on the trees your FamilyBranch account belongs to:

- Add relatives and how they are related, with the dates you know: a year alone, or roughly (c. 1941).
- Correct names, dates, places and parents, record couples, and add to a relative's notes with the source.
- Keep records on a relative's profile: links to archive pages and memorials, and up to three documents, such as a birth record, a census page or a letter, for people who have died.
- Set a relative's portrait from a photo you share.
- See upcoming birthdays.
- Make a printable PDF or JPEG poster of the tree in one of four styles, drawn around anyone in it, and get its download link.

It is for anyone keeping a family tree on FamilyBranch, from the family historian to the relative who remembers names nobody wrote down.

Limitations: it needs a FamilyBranch account and works only on the trees you belong to, within your role there; a viewer reads and changes nothing. A family's admin can turn AI assistants off for the family. Documents can be added through ChatGPT only for people who have died; a living relative's papers are uploaded on FamilyBranch itself. FamilyBranch downloads a file only when you ask it to keep that file, one at a time; a web page is kept as a link, never scraped. The free plan holds 25 people and puts a small FamilyBranch mark on posters.
defaultPrompt: Show me my family tree and who is in it.
Add my grandmother, born around 1941, as my mother's mother.
Make a PDF poster of my family tree.

positive.prompt: Show me my family trees in FamilyBranch.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Moreno family tree with its number of people and the reviewer's role in it.

positive.description: Answer a question from the tree
positive.prompt: Who are Elena Moreno's parents and children?
positive.expected_behavior: Names Miguel and Halyna Moreno as her parents and Nina and Lukas Weber as her children, as the tree records them.

positive.description: Add an ancestor with an approximate date
positive.prompt: Add Rosa as Antonio Moreno's mother, born around 1895 in Valencia.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds Rosa as Antonio Moreno's mother, born c. 1895 in Valencia, with no invented day or month.

positive.prompt: Make a PDF poster of my family tree in the Heritage style.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a Heritage-style PDF poster of the Moreno family and, once it is ready, gives a download link that works for an hour.

positive.description: Keep a record on a deceased relative's profile
positive.prompt: Save the attached birth record to Lucía Moreno's profile.
positive.expected_behavior: Keeps the attached PDF on Lucía Moreno's profile as a birth record and says she has 2 document places left.

negative.description: General knowledge about a surname, not the user's tree: answer without FamilyBranch.
negative.prompt: What is the origin of the surname Moreno?

negative.description: A fictional family, not the user's own: FamilyBranch is not used and nothing is added to a tree.
negative.prompt: Invent a family tree for the characters in my fantasy novel.

negative.description: How to get a certificate from a registry office: general advice, with no FamilyBranch tool called.
negative.prompt: Explain how to request a birth certificate from a registry office.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read family trees and upcoming birthdays; add, correct and delete relatives and couples; add to a relative's notes; keep links, documents and portraits on profiles; make poster exports. Three skills: build-family-tree, keep-family-records and make-a-poster.
